quarterly_data.signal: Johnson Controls' backlog, covering products and systems and services, totaled $16.6 billion at September 30, 2025. Building Solutions backlog was $14.9 billion, up 13% year over year, and Building Solutions orders for fiscal 2025 were $20.7 billion, up 7% (changes exclude acquisitions, dispositions and foreign currency). Remaining performance obligations were $22.7 billion, of which approximately 63% is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next two years.
